description: Trend Seeker helps founders and researchers find business problems backed by public market signals. Search or browse ideas, inspect the reasoning behind one idea, compare a shortlist, and open dated source evidence. Trend Seeker scores help prioritize further research. They are not forecasts, financial advice, or guarantees of demand.

defaultPrompt: Find business ideas for independent accountants who spend too much time on client follow-up.
Show recent business ideas in developer tools and explain the available evidence.
Compare two promising podcast business ideas and explain the evidence and biggest gaps for each.
